This Saxby CosmosEco V3 Fixed Fire Rated LED Recessed Downlight offers a high-performance lighting solution for a range of environments. With a dimmable function, it allows for adjustable illumination levels to suit any requirement. The fire-rated design enhances safety and compliance within building regulations, providing peace of mind for installers and end-users. An integrated LED delivers a cool white 4000K light output, producing 500 lumens for bright, energy-efficient illumination. Installation is streamlined for tradespeople with a 4-way, screwless push-fit terminal block, ensuring quick and secure wiring. Designed for a standard 57mm cut-out, it offers straightforward fitting into ceilings. This downlight is suitable for domestic and commercial installations, including kitchens, bathrooms, and high-traffic areas where durability and performance are essential. It features a satin nickel bezel and steel body, ensuring a professional finish and long-lasting performance, complemented by an extended 50,000-hour life. The IP65 rating confirms its suitability for use in bathroom zones, providing robust protection against dust and water jets.
